verdict.summary: Best-in-class profitability and capital generation across CEEMEA: 9M26 net profit rose 18.6% YoY to GEL 1,865.7m with 27.2% ROAE and 32.1% cost-to-income. Asset quality is benign (2.0% NPL, 0.7% CoR) and capital buffers robust (BoG CET1 18.1%, +260bp over 15.5% req; Ameriabank CET1 14.0%). Ratings track Georgia sovereign (BB).

positives: Sector-leading profitability: 27.2% ROAE and 32.1% CIR in 3Q26; 9M26 profit GEL 1,865.7m (+18.6% YoY).
Substantial capital headroom: BoG CET1 18.1% (+260bp over 15.5% NBG requirement) and Ameriabank CET1 14.0% (+200bp over 12.0% req).
Clean asset quality: 2.0% group NPL ratio and 0.7% 3Q26 cost of credit risk.
negatives: Rapid balance sheet expansion: Loans +24.6% YoY CC (GEL 46.5bn) and deposits +21.1% YoY CC require sustained underwriting discipline.
Georgian sovereign & political risk ceiling (BB) limits rating upside above sovereign.
Armenian subsidiary (Ameriabank) integration and regional FX/geopolitical exposure.

background.business_overview: FTSE-250 UK holding company (Lion Finance Group PLC) owning JSC Bank of Georgia (~38-40% Georgian market share) and Ameriabank (Armenia's leading bank).
background.asset_perimeter: Georgian Financial Services (Bank of Georgia) + Armenian Financial Services (Ameriabank, acquired Mar-24).
background.ownership_governance: London Stock Exchange Premium Listed; subject to UK corporate governance and NBG/CBA supervision.

recent_drivers: 9M/3Q 2026 Results: 9M profit GEL 1,865.7m (+18.6% YoY), Q3 GEL 661.9m (+21.0% YoY), ROAE 27.2%, NPL 2.0%, BoG CET1 18.1%.
Funding: Placed $300m 9.50% Perp AT1 (Apr-24, redeemed $100m old AT1) and GEL 450m 11.50% 2028 senior notes.
